content: Melvin-Koushki says the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk gives a broader overview of the science than the R. Ḥurūf and the R. Anjām, neither of which is concerned with practical-magical applications; he also says a letter to Shāhrukh in the Munshaʾāt-i Turka, accompanying a treatise on occult properties and occult sciences, most probably concerns the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk.
